summary: Abundia Global Impact Group filed an 8-K announcing a board-authorized stock repurchase plan effective August 25, 2026, allowing up to $5 million of common stock to be repurchased before December 31, 2026. The program, announced via press release on August 24, 2026, complements a recently disclosed credit facility that retired convertible debt. Purchases will be made in open market transactions under Rule 10b-18 and Rule 10b5-1. No specific price, premium, or advisor was named. The buyback is a capital return initiative; watch for execution pace and potential EPS support.
